verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a UI framework, so a desktop-app story is a fair question for it. But the evidence shows no first-party way to build native desktop applications. The only related item is the ability to write custom renderers, which is a developer building block for constructing such support, not the capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build native desktop applications by reusing my framework's component model and tooling

citations.quote: Universal: write custom renderers to use Solid anywhere
